Nothing has been ordered yet. Because you changed the quantity, I needed a new confirmation. It's for 5 Cheeseburgers from Burger Stop.

Your cart already holds 1 Patates Kızartması and 1 Milkshake. They are included in this order. If you want only the 5 cheeseburgers, tell me and I'll order just those.

The total is 1125 TL. Of that, 800 TL comes from your wallet and 325 TL from your card. Reply "confirm" to place it.

blocks.summary: The previous confirmation could not be used (unknown), so nothing was done. Place an order at Burger Stop for 1125.00 TL. 800.00 TL from your wallet and 325.00 TL charged to your saved card. Confirm again to proceed.
